> A switch to disable caching entirely, for anyone who wants every read to hit the instance live instead of the local cache.

### Upgrade Steps

* [ACTION REQUIRED] Update cwcli to v3.3.0. Caching stays enabled by default, so nothing changes for existing users unless they opt in.

### New Features

* A switch to disable caching entirely. `cwcli config cache disable` sets `[cache] enabled = false` in the config file (revert with `cwcli config cache enable`), and the `CWCLI_NO_CACHE` environment variable overrides that key per shell or in CI (`CWCLI_NO_CACHE=1` disables, `CWCLI_NO_CACHE=0` re-enables). With caching off, every read command (`inspect`, `status`, `where`, `open`, the `apps` group, and every `axi` read verb) resolves live, as if a fresh inspect ran each time, and can never serve a stale row. Nothing is written to or read from the cache database while it's off, and a pre-existing cache is left untouched, so re-enabling restores it. Tab completion degrades to a live or empty lookup, `auto-inspect` refuses to run (there's nothing left to keep warm), bench labels still work through their marker files, and safety-critical commands (`rm`/`rm-site`'s backup step, `apps checkout`'s wrong-copy detection) still get correct live data. `cwcli config show` (and `--json`) reports the cache's on/off state and any environment override.
